text:
Ibrahim: hey folks, I'm Ibrahim (joined last month) and my first live oncall is Tue night. a few quick onboarding checks?
Nina: welcome! main things: PagerDuty + MFA, runbook reads for your services, staging shadow, and access to alert dashboard.
Ibrahim: i have PD invite but not the service list, just "Redwood Global".
Ben: that means your team tags aren't mapped. @Nina can add 'payments-team' and 'sre-apps' tags. give it a few minutes then refresh.
Ibrahim: refreshed, still blank. any other steps?
ops-bot: reminder: new_oncall_device_pending for Ibrahim. Complete device registration: https://pd.redwood/setup
Nina: if it persists, open a ticket in #eng-identity with employee id + screenshot. they usually fix mapping within the day.
Ibrahim: filed ticket. next: where are the secure runbooks for key rotation?
Cara: secure runbooks sit behind vault docs (link in pinned). request view with the access form; include your manager sign-off.
Ibrahim: cool. how do we practice runbooks safely? don't want to trigger prod throttles.
Ben: use staging drill cluster. we have scripted playbooks that simulate failovers. join a shadow session first. ops-bot runs them Tue/Thu 16:00.
infra-bot: scheduled: staging-drill for Ibrahim Thu 16:00 (invite sent).
Ibrahim: what's our escalation policy if a pager doesn't respond? call tree?
Nina: escalation: oncall -> service owner -> oncall-lead -> pager-duty-manager. if no response and it's sev1, call the oncall-lead phone and open a war-room channel, ping @exec-oncall.
Ben: we prefer early escalation rather than guessing. add your steps to the alert timeline so the next person has context.
Ibrahim: whats the exact handoff syntax?
Cara: use /handoff in #eng-oncall. short, structured. example:
```
/handoff
Shift: Ibrahim -> Ben
Incidents: none
Notes: finished cache rotation test on staging
Followups: schedule key rotation runbook review
```
Ibrahim: any guidance on muting noisy alerts during deploy windows?
Nina: you can suppress alerts for planned maintenance but add a maintenance ticket and note which alert rules are suppressed. do NOT mute without ticket.
Ben: tip: set a temporary suppression with a clear expiry and add a comment linking the maintenance PR.
Ibrahim: ok. one more: if i fix something in the runbook during an incident, what's the process for changes?
Cara: make a docs-edit PR, mark it with 'oncall-docs' and link the incident. small edits can be merged by Docs lead; larger changes need a brief review.
ops-bot: reminder: oncall-bootcamp next Wed 09:30 (calendar invite sent).
Ibrahim: thanks all. i'll join the Thu drill and DM Nina my employee id for PD mapping.
Nina: great — ping if you want a pairing shift before Tue night.
Ben: welcome aboard! we'll shadow the first page together if you want.
Ibrahim: appreciate it :thumbsup:
